requirements.criterion: Native actions and reports expose usable functions and costs at character knowledge without author catalog spoilers.
requirements.proposedExpansion: Shared original panels group quiet passives, actionable verbs, ongoing jobs, rosters, report highlights, selected loadouts and learned evidence. Library lists only discovered/held/rumored information. Actual-future sight is a legitimate in-play knowledge channel; worker reports are opaque. Long-run archives retain concise structured causes and known explanation. Join G7 existing effect forms: time-stop greys/paused timers; rewind reverse log/anchor; Infinity approach/halving gaps; adaptation wheel and actual changed resistance; domain borders; theft sliding source; copy offset; clone body split; possession style bleed; space-fold contact; pocket-world weather; fate threads; transformation and large-scale aftermath. Anticipation/activation/contact/counter/aftermath follow committed effect order, with persistent traces reflecting actual state and perception. Preserve distinctive prior forms rather than replacing them with generic flash.
dependencies: G7 presentation owner: review/REQUIREMENTS.json; exact returned IDs integrated by G5
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing: skillExpansionPresentation and featurePowerPresentation native descriptor routes. Gap: generic selected-card presentation/report filtering and control binding.

requirements.title: Versioned card state and durable integration
requirements.criterion: Each selected cheat has an authoritative validated state owner and durable-before-live settlement.
requirements.proposedExpansion: Keep acquisition provenance in sources and runtime card state in an explicitly validated optional owner or defined schema extension. Store revision/lineage/anchor/result/claim/ruleset as needed, not arbitrary source properties. Migrate old saves with no invented cheat/history; preserve unsupported content through explicit refusal/disabled policy. No hook bus is presumed present: wire selected semantic events exactly once.
